spec.name: Furniture Side Table
spec.description: A compact oak side table with a broad square top, recessed aprons, and four chunky turned legs. Warm hand-painted grain and stepped leg profiles give it a cozy survival-built character. Bounds: x/z 0.25–15.75, y 0–16.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: small square oak side table with four turned blocky legs. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
